editorial:
Imagine meeting the love of your life in a beautiful town like Niigata, only to have everything ripped away by one bad stroke of luck. You get to follow Seijiro and Shizue, two people who have an instant connection but are forced apart by a cruel twist of fate. The vibe is heavy on romance and sadness, making you feel the ache of waiting for someone who might never come back. It starts off sweet, but it quickly turns into a story about how life can push you into corners you never wanted to be in, especially when you are just trying to survive.

What really hits home is the acting; you can see the pain in their eyes every time they realize how much time they have lost. The pacing is a bit slow, which fits the mood, though some might find the drama a bit too much. If you love stories about lost love and tough choices, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older gem, you might want to hunt for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night.
endingExplained: After years of separation, Seijiro finally returns to find that Shizue is married to a powerful yakuza boss. The tension peaks as they realize they still love each other but cannot be together because of her ties to the underworld. In the end, the tragedy comes full circle. They cannot escape their circumstances, and the story wraps up with a heartbreaking realization that some mistakes and timing issues can never be fixed, leaving them forever apart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tragic romance stories and old Japanese cinema.
